title: Placement: Decide Where Parts and Fields Appear | Orchard Core
description:
A display driver gives every part and field of a content item a default zone and position. Changing that place should not mean changing the driver.

A placement.json file in a module, a theme or the startup project overrides the default. Its rules target shapes by shape type, differentiator, display type, content type, content part and request path, and they move, hide, group or replace the shapes they match.

In this video:
• Shapes, zones and default locations
• The placement.json file: rules, filters and placement information
• Targeting parts, fields and editors with shape types and differentiators
• Places: zones, positions, tabs, cards and columns
• Moving a field and grouping another in the editor of an Article
• Which rule wins, and common mistakes
